say:2:1028219001:1.text: Magister! Look! I found a perfect "longsword!"
say:2:1028219001:1.male: Magister! Look! I found a perfect "longsword!"
say:2:1028219001:1.female: Magister! Look! I found a perfect "longsword!"

say:4:1028219002:1.text: It's long and straight! It isn't sharp, but it's the perfect weapon to practice with!
say:4:1028219002:1.source_cn: 它又长又直，虽然还不够锋利，但现在最适合当武器练手！

say:7:1028219003:1.text: I would like to, but I can't seem to stand straight right now...
say:7:1028219003:1.source_cn: 我、我也想，不过现在好像站不起来了……

say:9:1028219005:1.text: When I was collecting tree branches, a rabbit suddenly bolted out from the bushes...
say:9:1028219005:1.source_cn: 刚才去捡树枝的时候，有只兔子突然从草丛里窜出来……

say:10:1028219006:1.text: I-I wasn't scared! I just didn't want to hurt it!
say:10:1028219006:1.source_cn: 我、我才没被它吓到！我只是……不想伤到它！

say:12:1028219008:1.text: You must be in a lot of pain! Don't worry. There should be herbs around here we can use to make some medicine.
say:12:1028219008:1.source_cn: 你一定很疼吧！别担心，这附近应该有可以用来调配药剂的植物……

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你不会还要和我比剑术吧
